content:
Apple released the first public betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate today, alongside updated developer beta builds with new build numbers. Here are the details.

Updated Builds Accompany Public Betas

Alongside the first public betas, Apple has also released updated builds of the third developer betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate.

The updated third developer beta of iPadOS 27 carries build number 24A5380l, while the updated third beta of macOS 27 Golden Gate carries build number 26A5378n.

It's unclear why Apple pushed out these updated builds, as no widespread issues seem to have affected the prior builds. The changes could address issues discovered just before today's public beta release, but Apple has not shared any details.

We'll be keeping an eye on these new versions and report back if we find anything noteworthy.

Have you spotted anything new in the updated builds? Drop a comment and let us know.
